data.title: What to know about the total solar eclipse
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Day will briefly turn into night across a swathe of northern Spain on Wednesday, when the Moon will completely cover the Sun during a rare total solar eclipse.

data.title: Total solar eclipse to spellbind Europe

data.title: Trump's secret plane swap triggers questions and confusion

data.title: Colombia scrambles to find survivors as quake kills 240
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Colombian volunteers on Tuesday dredged through rubble, searching for survivors from an earthquake that killed at least 240 people and leveled more than a hundred homes and office buildings.

data.title: UN says 2 staff arrested by Afghan intelligence agency
data.description: KABUL - Two staff members of the United Nations mission in Afghanistan have been arrested by the country's intelligence agency, the world body told AFP on Tuesday, adding that it had no access to them for two days.

data.title: Pereira, the 'zombie city' devastated by Colombia's earthquake
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Jorge Gonzalez searches with his bare hands for his aunt under the ruins of a four-story building in Pereira, one of the cities hardest hit by the powerful earthquake in Colombia that has left at least 240 dead.

data.title: Flight cancelled after child refuses to buckle seat belt
data.description: A Canadian airline was forced to cancel a cross-country flight last week after a small child would not sit down and buckle a seat belt before takeoff.

data.description: NEW DELHI - The ‌captain of an Air India Phuket-Delhi flight that suddenly lost about 300 feet of altitude last week has tested positive for marijuana in a confirmatory ​drug test, multiple ⁠Indian media outlets reported on Tuesday.

data.title: Israel demolishes home of Palestinian killed in West Bank clash
data.description: TELL, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Tuesday demolished the home of a Palestinian who died in July in the most lethal clash in months in the occupied West Bank, residents and the army told AFP.

data.title: Air India CEO summoned over Phuket-Delhi flight incident

data.title: Syria sentences Assad to death in absentia for atrocities
data.description: DAMASCUS - A Syrian court on Tuesday sentenced former ruler Bashar al-Assad to death after a trial in absentia, convicting him of atrocities committed during the country’s nearly 14-year civil war.

data.title: French homebuyers rethink choices after heatwaves
data.description: PARIS - After multiple severe heatwaves in a single summer, French residents are increasingly factoring high temperatures into their home searches, realtors say, bumping up features such as shutters, air conditioning and indirect sunlight on their priority lists.

data.title: Ethiopian rebels condemn army drone strikes
data.description: ADDIS ABABA - Rebel authorities in the Tigray region of Ethiopia on Tuesday accused the federal government of carrying out deadly drone strikes in the northern region, denouncing “a serious escalation” amid fears of a new war.

data.title: Schools closed as Indonesia battles wildfires
data.description: SURABAYA (INDONESIA) — Dozens of Indonesian schools were shuttered for a second day Tuesday against the spreading haze of wildfires plaguing the archipelago at the start of a long and intense dry season worsened by El Nino.

data.title: Hungary parliament to elect Orban-critic judge as president
data.description: BUDAPEST — Hungarian lawmakers on Tuesday are expected to elect former supreme court chief Andras Baka, who was fired under ex-premier Viktor Orban, as the country's next head of state.

data.title: Russian barrage on Ukraine kills 9, wounds dozens
data.description: KYIV — Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least nine people overnight and wounded dozens, authorities said Tuesday, after Kyiv warned that Moscow had received more ballistic missiles from North Korea.

data.title: 40% of flights grounded in Shanghai as long-lived Typhoon Dolphin moves north
data.description: Shanghai airports cancelled nearly 40% of all flights on Monday as heavy rain continued after Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in eastern China on Sunday evening and continued to move north.

data.title: 2,300-year-old wine found near Great Wall ruin
data.description: BEIJING — A well-preserved bronze Warring States-era wine vessel containing 2,300-year-old wine was discovered at the Shanjiabao cemetery. Here it is pictured in the lab.

data.title: One year after Putin-Trump summit, 'spirit of Anchorage' dissipated
data.description: MOSCOW — In the year since United States President Donald Trump hosted Russian President Vladimir Putin on US soil for a summit designed to broker an end to Russia's offensive on Ukraine, the diplomatic initiative has fizzled out and the conflict has escalated.

data.title: Ceuta leader wants migrant detention centre after influx
data.description: MADRID - The leader of Ceuta demanded on Monday the detention and expulsion of the thousands of migrants wandering the Spanish north African territory's streets after last month's mass influx from Morocco.

data.title: Torment of Afghan fathers as daughters deprived of education
data.description: KABUL - Father after father Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) spoke to in Afghanistan about the education ban that stops their daughters going beyond primary school choked up in despair.

data.title: Return of displaced Syrian Kurds to hometown suspended after violence
data.description: HASAKEH (SYRIA) - The return of displaced Syrian Kurds to their northeastern hometown of Ras al-Ain was suspended on Monday after a first group of returnees was attacked, prompting protests in other Kurdish-majority parts of Syria.

data.title: Farage vs Count Binface: What to know about UK snap poll
data.description: LONDON - Hard-right UK politician Nigel Farage will be fighting for his parliamentary seat Thursday, going head-to-head with parody candidate Count Binface in snap polls.

data.title: Trump order pushes for overhaul of childhood vaccine schedule
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Monday pushing for a rethink of school vaccine mandates and repeating calls for the measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccine to be separated into three individual shots.

data.title: Colombia declares state of emergency after quake kills 111
data.description: PEREIRA (COLOMBIA) - Colombia on Monday declared a state of emergency following a powerful earthquake that caused at least 111 deaths and flattened dozens of buildings, trapping more victims underneath.
